grammar_reference.title: RAE–ASALE, Diccionario panhispánico de dudas, concordancia, section 3.6
grammar_reference.paraphrase: An adjective preceding coordinated nouns can modify them together while agreeing in gender and number only with the nearest noun.
grammar_reference.limit: This establishes a grammatical possibility, not the reporting author's intended scope or a clinical severity threshold.
grammar_reference.root_application: In the individually reviewed sentence No hay significativo derrame articular ni quistes poplíteos, singular significativo alone does not prove that cysts are outside the qualifier. With no separate size or categorical cyst assessment, preserve uncertainty. The narrower reading remains recorded. This does not rewrite source text, automatically relabel other reports, or generalize to differently positioned modifiers.

reconsiderations: My initial negative treated central signal as definitively isolated from a surface. Surface noncontact is only impressionistic and the tear exclusion is categorical-qualified; neither affirmatively establishes isolated intrasubstance degeneration. Retain current masked uncertainty.

Withdraw my initial assumption that singular preposed significativo excludes the coordinated cyst noun from its scope; the grammar reference permits shared scope. The full source supplies no separate categorical cyst assessment or amount.
My initial separate-clause negative overstated what singular agreement establishes. Shared qualifier scope is grammatically possible; no separate cyst amount resolves this source.

The same preposed qualifier can reach the coordinated cyst noun despite nearest-noun singular agreement. Withdraw my initial categorical negative and preserve the narrower second-reader interpretation separately.

The literal cyst sentence retains ambiguous qualifier scope. Neither the malformed unrelated marrow sentence nor an assumed template repair establishes categorical cyst absence; withdraw my initial negative.

My initial positive promoted nonspecific free-edge irregularity despite an expressly suspicious fraying-tear interpretation. This is not definite amputation, blunting, or displaced torn tissue; the full sentence leaves whether the irregularity is a tear unresolved.

The actual marginal thickening of a synovial fold with possible plica syndrome is informative abnormal synovial-structure evidence, unlike an incidental unaltered plica. It does not establish inflamed thickened lining. Reconsider missing to uncertain, retaining masking.

Explicit cortical irregularity is informative cortical-structure evidence even though attributed to adjacent cartilage disease. It neither establishes nor excludes acute disruption or a fracture line. My initial missing state discarded this structural mention; retain current uncertainty.

At most minimal retropatellar signal alteration is a directly bounded below-loss finding, not a bare cartilage grade. No competing PF cartilage defect is described. My initial uncertainty imposed an additional requirement to separately clear every PF surface; support the first reader's actual minimal-signal quote without treating the generic higher-grade denial alone as sufficient.

The complete source explicitly denies bone bruise. The focal patellar signal raises a specifically hedged fracture question but is not described as a possible bruise. My initial uncertainty generalized that separate fracture ambiguity across an unqualified contusion denial.

General initial degenerative changes are not expressly restricted to the subsequently named PF/lateral exclusions. My initial missing interpretation imposed exclusive localization absent from the text; retain uncertainty for incompletely localized cartilage degeneration.
Withdraw my initial unqualified cyst negative: the preposed significance adjective may scope across the coordinated nouns, and no separate cyst amount resolves that ambiguity.

My initial negative and both proposals treated impresiona as an unqualified preserved-morphology assertion. Here apparent preservation is paired with only absence of categorical tear criteria. Unlike a separate unqualified no-tear-signs statement, neither clause removes the report's qualification. Keep current uncertainty and reject both negative proposals.

The explicitly named synovial chondromatosis informs a synovial disease process even without proving inflammatory lining thickening. My missing interpretation was too restrictive about informative structure mention. Preserve current masked uncertainty; loose bodies are not a synovitis positive.

My initial negative transferred thin regional popliteal/pes-anserine fluid to the size of a Baker collection. The Baker denial is only significance-qualified, and regional fluid is not an explicit small Baker measurement. Withdraw that anatomical transfer.

My initial uncertainty relied on an intraosseous ganglion and generic reactive subchondral change. Neither passage describes marrow signal, edema, or impact injury. Unlike explicitly subchondral marrow edema, these structural findings do not provide a contusion assessment; use empty evidence and retain masking.

Although preservation is described impressionistically, the separate sin signos de rotura clause unqualifiedly denies tear signs. My initial uncertainty neglected that independent negative assertion; it differs from absence of categorical tear criteria.
The unqualified no-tear-signs clause covers both menisci and independently supports negative despite the preceding observational wording. Withdraw my initial uncertainty without changing the source.

No significant subchondral bony change is a generic structural statement, not a marrow signal or contusion assessment. My initial uncertain state inferred target relevance from subchondral location alone. Retain masking with empty evidence.

Unqualified proximal disruption with some displaced fragments establishes ACL injury but does not explicitly quantify complete or high-grade fiber loss. My initial positive supplied the omitted severity from the injury pattern; withdraw that inference.

The general knee OA conclusion says more severe at PF, leaving involvement elsewhere incompletely localized. My initial missing state treated the detailed PF descriptions as exclusive despite that comparative wording. Retain current uncertainty without inferring a medial positive.
General knee OA with PF predominance does not establish exclusive PF involvement. Withdraw the initial missing interpretation and preserve uncertainty for the unspecified lateral loss depth/extent.

My initial negative converted tiny focus into a verified subcentimeter bound. The relative adjective gives no measured scale, and high-grade alone also omits the explicit loss fraction. Preserve current uncertainty instead of introducing a universal dimensional mapping.

Singular unlocalized Bursa: Unremarkable does not identify the characteristic posterior bursa. My initial negative assigned that location despite separate suprapatellar fluid. Withdraw the ungrounded anatomical mapping and retain current missing state.

The explicit sin signos de rotura clause is unqualified, unlike sin criterios categoricos in other reports. It independently supports a negative despite impressionistic morphology wording; withdraw my initial uncertainty.
The separate no-tear-signs assertion covers both menisci. My initial uncertainty over-weighted the preceding observational verb and neglected this explicit denial.

The sentence directly says no joint effusion without a significance modifier. Its unusual y coordination leaves cyst scope ambiguous but does not qualify the preceding effusion denial. Withdraw my initial uncertainty for effusion only.

This is a source-level broad-region inference from denudation across connected surfaces, not a grade-only or universal facet-to-centimeter conversion. Reject the second proposal requiring an additional numeric region size.
